metadata.title: Río Negro Basin Explorer
metadata.description: Satellite explorer of the Río Negro basin: the Limay, Neuquén and Río Negro rivers and their tributaries.

modeled.regulated: Large dams regulate the Limay and the Neuquén today, so the flow in these rivers can differ a lot from the natural averages shown here.

landing.h1: Follow the water from the Andes to the Atlantic.
landing.sub: Explore the Limay, Neuquén and Negro rivers, their tributaries and sub-basins on satellite imagery.
landing.f2p: Switch from the whole basin to Limay, Neuquén and Río Negro, then drill into finer levels with breadcrumb navigation.
landing.d2: Discharge is a modeled natural average for 1971–2000 and does not reflect current dam regulation at El Chocón, Piedra del Águila, Alicurá and others. Population is a 2010 estimate.
